### Taking Off the Disguise
Author: Doug Fields
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/taking-off-the-disguise-homeword-july-16.html
Passage: Luke 16:14-15
Points:
- People often put on religious masks to project spiritual maturity and hide their personal flaws.
- Pretending is comfortable and safe, while genuine honesty requires vulnerability and courage.
- Jesus rejected the hypocrisy of the Pharisees, who valued outward appearances while ignoring inner corruption.
- God sees the reality of our hearts and prefers authentic brokenness over empty spiritual performances.
- Resting in God's unconditional love frees believers to take off their disguises and live for Him.
